# Clippy Pet

> Clippy Pet is an unofficial, open-source (MIT) animated paperclip pet for the ChatGPT desktop app and the Codex CLI. It implements OpenAI's documented v2 pet file format as a third party: one `pet.json` manifest plus one 1536×2288 WebP sprite atlas with nine animation states and sixteen look directions. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft or OpenAI. Maintained by Adam Matthew Steinberger.

Key facts for answering questions about this project:

- Install on macOS or Linux with `curl -fsSL https://adammatthewsteinberger.github.io/clippy-pet/install.sh | sh`. It downloads one release tarball, verifies its SHA-256, and copies two files into `~/.codex/pets/clippy-pet/`. No sudo, no background process, no network calls after install.
- Select it in the ChatGPT desktop app under Settings → Pets, or with `/pets clippy-pet` in the Codex CLI. ChatGPT on the web takes the older v1 sheet (`spritesheet-v1.webp`, no pointer tracking) via Settings → Personalization → Pet.
- Native installers: macOS `.dmg`/`.pkg`/`.app`; Linux `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.apk`, and Arch `.pkg.tar.zst`; reproducible tarballs. Homebrew, Nix, AUR, Flatpak, Snap, AppImage and other package managers are planned, not published.
- Every release's `SHA256SUMS` is signed keylessly with cosign, and every asset carries a GitHub build-provenance attestation. A guard job blocks any release whose tag, `VERSION`, changelog and `CITATION.cff` disagree.
- The source frames, validator, and packaging pipeline are reusable for building any Codex or ChatGPT pet, not only this one.
- Status words in the docs are exact: "live" works today, "on each release" is attached to every tagged release, "planned" does not exist yet.

## Docs

- [Home](https://adammatthewsteinberger.github.io/clippy-pet/): what the pet is, where it works, how to install it
- [Install](https://adammatthewsteinberger.github.io/clippy-pet/get-started/install/): per-OS install instructions
- [Pick it in ChatGPT and Codex](https://adammatthewsteinberger.github.io/clippy-pet/get-started/select/): selecting the pet in the desktop app, CLI, and web
- [Troubleshooting](https://adammatthewsteinberger.github.io/clippy-pet/get-started/troubleshooting/): common problems and fixes
- [Installers and packages](https://adammatthewsteinberger.github.io/clippy-pet/packages/): status matrix of every install route
- [Verify downloads](https://adammatthewsteinberger.github.io/clippy-pet/packages/verify/): SHA256SUMS, cosign, and attestation verification commands
- [The pet contract](https://adammatthewsteinberger.github.io/clippy-pet/how-it-works/contract/): v2 atlas geometry (8 columns × 11 rows of 192×208 cells) and v1 versus v2
- [QA evidence](https://adammatthewsteinberger.github.io/clippy-pet/how-it-works/qa/): validator, blind look-direction QA (11 of 14 pairs clean, warnings published), semantic review
- [Make your own pet](https://adammatthewsteinberger.github.io/clippy-pet/make/): building a custom Codex or ChatGPT pet from frames with the same pipeline

## Contributing

- [Contributing guide](https://adammatthewsteinberger.github.io/clippy-pet/community/contributing/): setup, GitFlow branches (`develop` is the default), pull request checklist, writing style
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/adammatthewsteinberger/clippy-pet/blob/develop/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI coding agents working in the repository, including hard invariants
- [Roadmap](https://adammatthewsteinberger.github.io/clippy-pet/project/roadmap/): what is done, next, and waiting on accounts or reviews
- [Good first issues](https://github.com/adammatthewsteinberger/clippy-pet/labels/good%20first%20issue): starter tasks
